names.price_edge: price edges (one book out of line with the others)

weak.nhl_prop: live results are below promise: 11-7 against 13.0 wins expected (-0.2 units). No stake until that recovers.

rules.bet: Passed testing at today's price: the bet type beat the closing price on games the model never saw, the projection agrees, 3%+ value.
rules.early: Passed testing at the opening line - bet before it moves: the bet type beat the opening line on games the model never saw, and today's number is still the opener.
rules.provisional: Bet early (provisional): passed testing against the opening line; still being confirmed at real sportsbook openers. Its opener history is Action Network's opening line, which is often not a number any US sportsbook posted, so the stake is capped at 0.5 units until 50 graded bets at real sportsbook openers (Locksmith's line poller) confirm it.
rules.marginal: Bet (marginal): passed testing at today's price, but the rule was picked from many tried and its record sits right at the bar that search needs, so the stake is capped at 1 unit.
rules.lean: Lean: no money. Locksmith rates it above the price, but bets like it have not passed testing at this price.
rules.price_edge: A price edge is one book paying more than the other books' own chance (cut removed) says it should. It is a bet only where the certificate says these bets beat the out-of-line book on games never used to choose the rule; elsewhere it is shown as information. Thresholds: {"nba": 0.04, "nhl": null, "nfl": 0.03, "cfb": null, "wnba": 0.0, "ufc": 0.0}.
rules.k_why: Value and stake use a chance pulled halfway to the market's no-vig chance (p_used = market + 0.5 x (ours - market)). On the 114 graded live bets, 0.5 is the setting that scored best (log loss 0.6789 vs the market's 0.6848 and the raw chances' 0.6849); at the price you bet, past bets kept 35-65% of the promised edge.
